name: FXOapps Instant Search for Woocommerce
author: FXOapps

sections.description:
FXOapps Instant Search for Woocommerce adds a fast product autocomplete search box to your store. Shoppers see matching products as they type, and you control search scope, suggestion layout, mobile behavior, and styling from wp-admin.

This WordPress.org release includes a complete core search experience without a license or external account.

What shoppers get

✓ Instant AJAX product suggestions while typing
✓ Product rows with optional thumbnail, price, SKU, description, and stock status
✓ Keyboard navigation in the suggestion panel
✓ “See all results” link to the WooCommerce product search page
✓ Mobile-friendly layouts — search bar or icon mode, flexible breakpoints, optional fullscreen overlay

What shop owners get

✓ Search configuration — enable/disable search, minimum characters, max suggestions, debounce, search scope (description, excerpt, short description, SKU; product title always included), exclude out-of-stock products
✓ Autocomplete display — show or hide product image, price, SKU, and description in suggestions
✓ Appearance — Solaris, Minimal, and Modern styles; search bar, icon, or responsive icon layouts; input colors and borders; custom preloader; darkened background overlay
✓ Shortcode — embed the search form anywhere with [fxoapps_instant_search] (legacy aliases supported)
✓ Analytics — optional search phrase logging with a top-50 phrase table in wp-admin
✓ Translations — editable storefront strings; compatible with WPML and Polylang
✓ Debug — environment checks and search test tools in wp-admin

PRO features (separate commercial plugin)

Upgrade to PRO

Advanced features are available in FXOapps Instant Search PRO for Woocommerce. PRO is a separate licensed plugin — not included in this free release.

Search intelligence

✓ Synonyms for alternative product names
✓ Fuzzy matching for typos and misspellings
✓ Fast and Broad search presets

Rich result types

✓ Category and tag suggestions in autocomplete
✓ Brand matches in the dropdown
✓ Search in product attributes

Shopper experience

✓ Details panel with product preview
✓ Add to cart directly from search results
✓ User search history for returning shoppers

Performance & control

✓ Dedicated search index with incremental updates and full rebuild
✓ Advanced indexer with memory and SQL modes
✓ Include or exclude products by taxonomy rules
✓ One-click updates from WordPress (active license)

Merchandising & analytics

✓ Search redirects to products, categories, or custom URLs
✓ Boost, pin, and bury products per search query
✓ Variation-aware search by size, color, and attributes
✓ Custom field, GTIN, EAN, barcode, and ACF meta search
✓ Popular empty-state and zero-results rescue suggestions
✓ Zero-result and click analytics in the admin

See FXOapps Instant Search → Settings → Pro features in wp-admin for the full list.

Upgrade to PRO

Merchant setup

After activation, open FXOapps Instant Search → Settings and configure:

  1. Starting — copy the shortcode or template snippet for your theme
  2. Search bar — placeholder, minimum characters, styles, layout, and colors
  3. Autocomplete — suggestion limit, labels, and product display toggles
  4. Search config — enable search, debounce, and search scope
  5. Analytics — review top search phrases and tune your catalog
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate FXOapps Instant Search for Woocommerce through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to FXOapps Instant Search → Settings and configure search scope and appearance.
  5. Add the shortcode to your theme header, widget area, or a page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a license or external account?

No. This release works without a license key, subscription, or fxoapps.com account.

Is there a PRO version?

Yes. FXOapps Instant Search PRO for Woocommerce is a separate commercial plugin with advanced indexing, synonyms, fuzzy matching, category/tag/brand results, add-to-cart from search, merchandising, and licensed updates. See Settings → Pro features in wp-admin or Upgrade to PRO. PRO is not required for core instant search.

Where can I get support?

Use the plugin support forum on WordPress.org.

Does the plugin call external services?

No. This release does not phone home, send telemetry, or contact a license server. Search requests run on your WordPress site.

Can I customize the search box styling?

Yes. Use the Search bar settings tab for built-in styles, layouts, and colors. For additional CSS, use Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS in WordPress.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • WordPress.org release: core instant search without license or updater in the free build.
  • Pro features tab in settings lists PRO capabilities and upgrade link (marketing only).
  • Remove custom CSS field; use WordPress Customizer for additional styling.
